title: Running Gemma 4 26B at 5 tokens/sec on a 13-year-old Xeon with no GPU #Shorts
description:
A 26-billion-parameter AI model running on a 13-year-old Xeon with zero GPU — at a usable 5 tokens per second. Heavy quantization via llama.cpp is doing the heavy lifting, compressing model weights enough to run entirely on system RAM. If you have an old workstation sitting around, you might already have a private local AI setup waiting to happen.

#localai #selfhostedai #llmcpp #machinelearning #aitools #llm #homelab #developerlife #Shorts
